description.description: A collage showing four images of a blonde woman alongside an overlay of a social media post. The images on the left show the woman looking significantly more tanned or with darker makeup than the headshots on the right. The centered social media post contains text commenting on the double standards of performance-based racial transformations.
description.ocrText: Erika Kirk @MrsErikaKirk But if I did blackface as part of a skit, I'd be cancelled and called a racist.
